text: Terminal faults and user traps shall not be caught by `invoke`. Foreign exceptions shall cross only a defined adapter translating to E; an unexpected exception at a non-raising boundary shall be contained and terminate with `invalid_foreign_transfer`, or the interface shall be rejected when enforcement cannot be established.
